# AGENTS.md — 24-pixel-game

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this folder.

## Context
- Template: **LAMPLIGHTER**, indie game, style "8-bit cartridge box & manual".
- Stack: Vanilla JS, Canvas, Vite. Do not add dependencies unless the user asks.
- The design contract is in `DESIGN.md`. Read it before changing anything visual.

## Files
- `src/game.js` — game engine, palette and sprites
- `src/main.js` — page logic, all copy (EN + RU), sprite sheet
- `index.html` — box, screen, manual markup
- `src/style.css` — tokens at the top

## How to run
- `npm install`
- `npm run dev`
- `npm run build   # ./dist`

## Rules
- Content changes go to the content file, not into markup or components.
- Every user-facing string exists in **en** and **ru**. English is the default; `?lang=ru` and the language button switch it.
- Colors, fonts, radii and spacing are tokens. Change tokens, not individual elements.
- Keep the signature block: A playable one-screen 8-bit game on canvas (keyboard + touch pad): light lamps across the rooftops, dodge bats.
- Keep accessibility: semantic headings, visible focus, alt text, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
- Keep it static: no backend, no booking or payment flows.
- Pixels stay crisp: canvases use image-rendering: pixelated, sprites are palette strings.
- Press Start 2P only for short labels; Pixelify Sans for reading text.
- Game palette is limited (9 colours) and defined once in game.js.
- The page explains controls visually (controller diagram) before asking you to play.
- No external assets: sprites, box art and sound-free gameplay are all code.

## Done means
- The page builds/opens without console errors.
- Both languages render with no missing strings.
- Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px wide.
